Imagery covers AOI [79.78, 11.8, 79.98, 12.02], not necessarily the full named region. Drift uses 12.0h RK4 integration steps; this is not merely trajectory output sampling.

PARTIAL RUN. Real imagery, detection and verification, but 1 input(s) were absent on the exporting machine, so the agents below ran degraded rather than on real data. This is not a full six-agent result: Dark-vessel correlation (FR-5) — no SAR/AIS records; no correlation.
Obtain the missing datasets with `python scripts/fetch_data.py --instructions`, then re-export without --allow-degraded.

EXPLORATORY INDIAN OCEAN PILOT. This bounded Puducherry coastal AOI is not an Indian Ocean survey. No independent local ground truth or detection accuracy is established; verified means passing model checks, not confirmed ghost nets.

GFW unavailable: buffered 7-day and full-window requests returned a null SAR dataset payload, which the adapter rejected. This is not evidence of no vessels or no SAR coverage. The missing component is dropped and available priority weights are redistributed.

Acquisition selection: STAC survey found January 5-20 scenes 71-100 percent cloudy. The fixed January 21-February 1 window uses a 40 percent scene filter; existing per-AOI cloud/water screening and all scientific thresholds remain unchanged. Requested rectangles are not complete cloud-free observation masks.

Regional configuration was added on codex/coverage-indian-ocean after the recorded pipeline-code commit. Dataset extracts: 71 Meijer river mouths within 250 km; one Protected Planet marine area within 100 km. Its centroid/radius approximation has circle fit 0.30. OSCAR files were reused; drift uses a time-mean field and 12-hour integration steps.
